headline: WBC mnemonic: Never Let Monkeys Eat Bananas
stat_note: most to least common in normal blood
body: Neutrophils 40–60%, Lymphocytes 20–40%, Monocytes 2–8%, Eosinophils 1–4%, Basophils 0.5–1% of all white cells.
source: Source: MedlinePlus (U.S. NLM), Blood differential test

headline: Red blood cells live only about 4 months
stat_note: days: the average life of a red blood cell
body: Your bone marrow constantly makes new red blood cells to replace the old ones as they wear out.

headline: The hyoid is the bone that touches no other bone
body: This U-shaped bone sits in the front of your neck below the jaw. Muscles, ligaments and cartilage hold it in place to support the tongue and help you swallow and speak.
